cells.gaps: Nothing found says the central bank's biometric financial ID is in use; SIM registration requires the ID card with no check against a register stated, and the 2023 statement of absence is outside the window.
cells.note: The central bank signed a contract in November 2024 for a biometric financial ID to verify customers, with tests planned at banks and mobile money operators (BDI-004): contracted, so stage 2. Nothing says it is in service.
